name: Maureen "Mo" Murphy
prior_offices: Teton County clerk (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026; listed on the official clerk page)
background: Maureen "Mo" Murphy is the Teton County clerk and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The official clerk page lists her in that office. The Jackson Hole News&Guide reported that she, a Republican, ran unopposed in the general election.

sources.name: Jackson Hole News&Guide, Nov. 4, 2026, Ashlee Nader wins race for Teton County assessor
